listing.name: Diablo: Hellfire (DevilutionX)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Mature native port with desktop packages and explicit original-data setup. Limits: Established Diablo/Hellfire engine; separate game data and shareware limits apply. Portcove gameplay/lifecycle untested. Upstream platforms: Official desktop runtime packages for Windows/Linux/macOS. README documents Windows x86-64, Linux x86/x86-64/AArch64 and macOS x86-64 build jobs; selected package architectures require asset selection. Original data: Own Diablo DIABDAT.MPQ plus Hellfire hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq and hfvoice.mpq. Diablo shareware spawn.mpq does not supply the Hellfire expansion. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
